package handlers

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"testing"

	answeruc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/answer"
)

func TestBuildStudentTaskResponseRedactsAssessmentAnswerKeys(t *testing.T) {
	correctOrder := 2
	metadata := &answeruc.TaskMetadata{
		ID:            "task-id",
		LessonID:      "lesson-id",
		CodeStructure: json.RawMessage(`{"type":"quiz_theory","quiz":{"expected_answers":["secret"],"trim_space":true}}`),
		Tests: []answeruc.TaskTestMetadata{
			{
				ID: "single-choice", Kind: "single_choice", Title: "Choose", Order: 1,
				Variants: []answeruc.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
					{ID: "single-a", Text: "A", IsCorrect: true, Order: 1},
					{ID: "single-b", Text: "B", Order: 2},
				},
			},
			{
				ID: "ordering", Kind: "ordering", Title: "Order", Order: 2,
				Variants: []answeruc.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
					{ID: "order-a", Text: "A", CorrectOrder: &correctOrder, Order: 1},
				},
			},
			{
				ID: "classification", Kind: "classification", Title: "Classify", Order: 3,
				Groups: []answeruc.TaskTestGroupMetadata{
					{ID: "group-a", Title: "Group A", Order: 1},
				},
				Variants: []answeruc.TaskTestVariantMetadata{
					{ID: "class-a", Text: "A", GroupID: "group-a", GroupSourceKey: "group-a-key", Order: 1},
				},
			},
		},
	}

	payload, err := json.Marshal(buildStudentTaskResponse(metadata))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("marshal student task response: %v", err)
	}

	var decoded any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &decoded); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("decode student task response: %v", err)
	}
	assertJSONKeysAbsent(t, decoded, map[string]struct{}{
		"is_correct":       {},
		"correct_order":    {},
		"group_id":         {},
		"group_source_key": {},
		"expected_answers": {},
	})

	response := buildStudentTaskResponse(metadata)
	if len(response.Tests) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("tests count = %d, want 3", len(response.Tests))
	}
	classification := response.Tests[2]
	if classification.Kind != "classification" || len(classification.Groups) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("classification rendering data missing: %+v", classification)
	}
	if classification.Groups[0].ID != "group-a" || classification.Groups[0].Title != "Group A" {
		t.Fatalf("classification group changed: %+v", classification.Groups[0])
	}

	if !metadata.Tests[0].Variants[0].IsCorrect || metadata.Tests[1].Variants[0].CorrectOrder == nil || metadata.Tests[2].Variants[0].GroupID != "group-a" {
		t.Fatal("trusted answer keys were removed from internal task metadata")
	}
	if !json.Valid(metadata.CodeStructure) || !containsJSONKey(metadata.CodeStructure, "expected_answers") {
		t.Fatal("trusted text-quiz answer key was mutated")
	}
}

func containsJSONKey(payload json.RawMessage, key string) bool {
	var decoded map[string]any
	if json.Unmarshal(payload, &decoded) != nil {
		return false
	}
	_, direct := decoded[key]
	if direct {
		return true
	}
	for _, value := range decoded {
		encoded, _ := json.Marshal(value)
		if containsJSONKey(encoded, key) {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func assertJSONKeysAbsent(t *testing.T, value any, forbidden map[string]struct{}) {
	t.Helper()
	switch item := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for key, nested := range item {
			if _, exists := forbidden[key]; exists {
				t.Fatalf("student response leaked forbidden key %q", key)
			}
			assertJSONKeysAbsent(t, nested, forbidden)
		}
	case []any:
		for _, nested := range item {
			assertJSONKeysAbsent(t, nested, forbidden)
		}
	}
}
